title: Austin expands housing affordability
meeting_type: Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) Board of Directors AHFC Meeting
summary:
*   **New Affordable Housing Land Acquisition:** Acquired prime land on Cullen Lane to build future affordable housing, leveraging funds from the 2018 housing bonds.
*   **Preserving Existing Affordable Homes:** Initiated a master plan to ensure long-term, deeper affordability at the Harbors at Creekside property.
*   **Developing More Affordable Units:** Greenlit a new non-profit partnership to develop over 140 affordable rental units and additional homeownership options in Central East Austin.
*   **Aiding People Experiencing Homelessness:** Approved contracts with local organizations to provide professional services and rapid re-housing initiatives.
